title: Rebuilding after the Tsunami
description: The devastation from the March 2011 earthquake and tsunami plunged Japan into a dire situation, which called upon both Japanese nationals and U.S. Forces to help rebuild and recover. Lance Cpl. Joshua Defour asked those who were involved in the rebuilding to reflect on that effort.
keywords: tsunami, earthquake, rebuilding, Operation Tomodachi, MINAMISANRIKU TOWN, Japan
